full_details: At nine you were at the Theatre. The plot was on the peg, the title turned away, and the two hired men were in the tiring-house from the night. You were home again before noon, and back at two for Richard the Third. The almanac still prints the day for leases and reckonings, and nobody is keeping it. A Rose bill in the house was Long Meg, title only. At the window you said the play at the Theatre was thin and that you were a duke in it. You did not name the play. Then you said what your father used to tell of this day when he was young: whole towns, the trades playing Scripture on waggons, the glovers among them, Herod raging in the street. All of it gone before you could see it. He tells it as a man tells a fair he was at. Players, you said, are a thing the Mayor writes letters about. Same trade. Different day. You named no town.
one_sentence: You rehearsed at nine, the almanac still printed Corpus Christi, played a duke in a thin Richard the Third, and said so at the window.
title: The day the almanac still prints Corpus Christi
